title: Unit 1 Unit Exercise — Section A
subtitle: who(m) / which / that · POINT 1·2 (p. 155)
introKo: 이 연습은 Section A 4문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기)으로 되어 있어요.

sections.title: Section A
sections.instructionKo: 다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요 (단, that은 제외). POINT 1·2. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)

items.sectionInstructionKo: 다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요 (단, that은 제외). POINT 1·2. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.label: A1
items.promptEn:
Those people are the volunteers. They clean up the park.
→ Those people are the volunteers ________________.
accept: Those people are the volunteers who clean up the park.
Those people are the volunteers who clean up the park

items.label: A2
items.promptEn:
The apples are for you. They are in the basket.
→ The apples ________________ are for you.
accept: The apples which are in the basket are for you.
The apples which are in the basket are for you

items.promptEn:

→ The Earth is a planet ________________.
accept: The Earth is a planet which goes around the Sun.
